issues.body: Section 4c still calls strict HEAD_RE + same-repo head + an "App-bot author" the authoritative producer conjunction, and its condition table still points to backfill-provenance.py:828's login.endswith("[bot]") check. That line is only a coarse prefilter. The actual recovery path later calls run_identity_from_log, which extracts the provenance job's anchored bot_login and requires anchored["bot_login"] == live_author; the source explicitly states that any *[bot] is not enough. Thus a PR opened by different-bot[bot] on a strict numeric same-repo branch satisfies the recommended manifest predicate but cannot be recovered as a worker record. Enumerating it creates a permanent, unrepairable expected-record gap and contradicts the claimed exact population.
issues.fix_hint: Define a sound independent way for the generator to identify the exact expected App-bot login and require equality, or incorporate the run-bound author validation through another complete mechanism. Correct the condition table and recommendations so line 828 is not presented as the full author contract. Add a negative self-test using a strict-shaped, same-repo PR authored by a different [bot] login; the existing generic non-bot case does not exercise this boundary.
issues.title: Worker author predicate still admits records the producer rejects

verdict.summary: The round-4 major finding remains unresolved. The document still defines the worker population as strict HEAD_RE + same-repo head + an unspecified "App-bot author", and still cites backfill-provenance.py:828's coarse login.endswith("[bot]") prefilter as the author condition. But a worker record is admitted only after run_identity_from_log extracts the provenance job's exact bot_login and requires it to equal the live PR author. A different installed App bot can therefore author a strict-shaped same-repo PR that the proposed generator enumerates even though backfill must refuse it, creating the permanent partial-evidence gap the design aims to avoid. Because the same major finding persists at the same severity, progress is stagnant.
